proposition: In letter 18 (825/1422?, Herat) Ibn Turka complains that after two days in attendance at Bāysunghur's court he had still not been allowed to see the prince and proposes a majlis as an easier setting: access to the patron was granted only in part.

mediation.where: Munshaʾāt-i Turka letter 18; MS Majlis 10196 f. 139a
mediation.note: Written by a supplicant asking a ruler or official for clemency, relief or a stipend; framed to win the favour asked, not as a neutral report.

mediation.who: Melvin-Koushki, summarising, dating and identifying the letter(s)
mediation.note: Date and place are MK's conjecture ('825/1422?')
